_why: THE BRANCH BOOK of the under-side series: building_cost = anchor x 2.0^era (600 / 1,200 / 2,400 / 4,800; 800 / 1,600 / 3,200 / 6,400) with the eager-spending define set (MONEY_SPENDING_CONSTRUCTION_TOO_LARGE_INVESTMENT_POOL_FACTOR 0.99 (⚠ 1.0, the cap vanilla's own comment names, is REJECTED by the engine's validator - its range is [0,1) - and the key then keeps VANILLA's 0.75, BELOW the canon's 0.9: landmine L33, found 2026-09-15 at the first run of canon-c19-in12-eager, and it cost F121 one of its four levers. Every unrun eager book was regenerated at 0.99), CRITICAL 1.25, EXCESSIVE 3.0, CONSTRUCTION_MAX_NUM_PRODUCTION_BUILDING_CONSTRUCTIONS_SCALED 0.05; LONG / VERY_LONG 160 / 240) - launched ONLY if canon-c19-in12-eager AND canon-c195-in12-eager both overshoot the band (a run above 1.3x at 1936 under the stop rule, or medians above 1.1x). It sits between C 1.95 and C 2.05 (F121: bistable - two stalls locked in by early British disasters, one growth seed at 1.32x), so the bistability risk is real and the config is not read before n=3 (the 2+1 rule's third run is expected, not exceptional). Everything but the slope as canon-c195-in12-eager.

THE ADOPT RULE (the loss-minimising iterator, 2026-09-17 evening): the incumbent is canon-c19-in12 at consensus loss 7.6 (F131; its clean seeds 5.3 / 9.5, its soft-line seed 44.4, one seed broken). After the pair (and the tie-breaker on F114 divergence): a HARD break in any run = the config is OUT (one broken run ends it). Otherwise read `criteria.mjs --arm <sessions>:<setup>`: the candidate REPLACES the incumbent only if its consensus loss is below 7.6 by at least 3 (the incumbent's own clean pair differs by 4, so a median of two moves by about 3 on seed noise alone) OR it is better on each of the three largest terms (the pool's GDP, the pool's hoard, world GDP) with no new soft breach; read the PER-SEED losses beside the consensus — a seed that crosses a soft line jumps by 10 x the line's weight, so two seeds at 3 and 40 are not better than two at 5 and 9.
